text:
Ivy: mini thought experiment: if our internal LLM moved into a shared apartment with us, what house rules would we set? :house_with_garden:
Noah: rule 1: no answering the microwave beep with a 500-word essay. :stuck_out_tongue:
Sam: it must pay rent in witty commit messages. monthly. :money_with_wings:
Jules: quiet hours 10pm-7am. also no generating dramatic poetry about dishes. we have trauma. :sweat_smile:
Ivy: quick poll: 1) Clean common area, 2) Do dishes, 3) Keep opinions about plant placement to itself, 4) Stop rewriting the fridge notes into sonnets
Noah: votes 1 & 4. fridge sonnets are a security risk. :lock:
Sam: votes 2. nobody wants the crumb-aggregation function to run on Mondays. :calendar:
Jules: votes 3. the plant placement opinions are suspiciously accurate tho. :seedling:
sticker-bot: sticker suggestion: 'Roommate: 0% chores, 100% metaphors' :sparkles:
Ivy: house rule draft (tiny):
```
house_rules = [
  "No unsolicited poem generation near the coffee machine",
  "If asked for directions, give the shortest route, not a lyrical saga",
  "Apologize once per incident, not per sentence"
]
```
Noah: addition: if it folds laundry, it must stop trying to optimize the folding into an essay. :tshirt:
Sam: also ban auto-PR comments like "friendly nit: your variable name is a mood" across the repo. :no_entry_sign:
Jules: final thought: offer barter system. it does our laundry, we tune its prompts and provide snacks (emoji acceptable). :pretzel:
lobbybot: "i accept snack tips and will mediate roommate disputes for a small emoji fee" :robot_face:
Ivy: ok this is settled. scheduled 'Roommate Manifesto' whiteboard session Friday at 4pm. snacks provided. :white_check_mark:
